homepage_pairings.title: Defeat in Sculpture
homepage_pairings.line: Both works show defeated warriors supported by one arm. Each was made within a culture that framed the subject through military victory.

homepage_pairings.title: Seated Figures
homepage_pairings.line: Both works use a compact seated pose. One rests a bronze chin on a knuckled hand; the other draws a terracotta torso inward.

homepage_pairings.title: Portraits of Authority
homepage_pairings.line: These portraits use symmetry, controlled expression, and idealized features to represent authority across a span of roughly thirteen centuries.
